create_funnel_tokenizer: create a FunnelTokenizer instance with a vocab file and custom special tokens for sequence processing
build_wordpiece_tokenizer: build a WordPiece-based tokenizer with BertNormalizer and BertPreTokenizer for Funnel Transformer inputs
tokenize_single_sequence: tokenize a single text sequence with cls and sep tokens using FunnelTokenizer's post processor
tokenize_pair_sequence: tokenize a pair of text sequences with separate token type ids for Funnel Transformer classification
configure_lowercase_tokenizer: configure the FunnelTokenizer to lowercase text, clean whitespace, and strip accents before tokenization
